content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Surprise

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's documented requirements—which account for your educational background and years managing projects—before you apply. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can help you verify your qualifications against PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend synchronous sessions from your Surprise location on a schedule that fits your work calendar. Our certified instructors guide you through the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world case studies across all sessions.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, complete your official PMI application online and pay the required exam fee. You'll need your Granite PM Academy course completion certificate and documentation of your project experience. PMI reviews and approves your application before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and optional review sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center convenient to you. Sit for the computer-based exam and receive your results within five business days.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP remains active for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, leading projects, volunteering, or publishing. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting your PDU hours and renewal fee to PMI to stay current in your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
